description: This file defines the RedisEventSubscriber class responsible for subscribing to Redis channels, handling events, and streaming data via SSEStreamer. It manages Redis client connection, event listeners, and message processing for various event types.

classes.name: RedisEventSubscriber
classes.description: A class that manages Redis subscriptions, handles incoming messages, and streams events to clients via SSEStreamer.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes Redis client based on environment variables, sets up event listeners, and assigns the SSEStreamer instance.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up Redis client event handlers for connect, ready, error, end, and reconnecting events.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a Redis channel if not already subscribed and sets up message handling.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Parses incoming Redis messages and streams corresponding events via SSEStreamer based on event type.
